environment_notes: OLD = local Laravel 5.7 master on http://127.0.0.1:8001 (DB faber_local). NEW = https://staging5.faberconnect.com. They do NOT share a DB; ids, timestamps and pre-existing constants differ by design and are covered by structural_only rules declared pre_run.

Fixtures (contractor, worker, company, project, request, match) were created this run through the API, in the same order on both sides (setup steps). Admin accounts are pre-existing on each side (admin role cannot be granted via API).

Match chain uses admin endpoints on our own fixture rows (POST /admin/match, PATCH /admin/worker/{wid}, /admin/match/{id}/found, /accept-worker). The request created by the contractor API was edited with PATCH /admin/request/{id} to cover Mon 2026-10-26..Fri 2026-11-06 (setup REQ_FIX).
Run date Wed 2026-10-28 (America/Phoenix = America/Vancouver offset -07:00 that day). Week under test starts Mon 2026-10-26.

NEW confirmation codes were read from the Grok Bot inbox (message ids in setup out_of_band); OLD codes from OLD storage/logs/laravel.log (MAIL_DRIVER=log). NEW registration captcha tokens minted from NEW /captcha-widget (hours_p1.py).

Not done on staging5 by policy: worker late/withdraw types 13/14/15 and admin late type 13 (real Slack/push and replacement-request notifications on shared staging, plan F-5/F-9); approve-hours email/SMS tokens (plan F-5). No faked clock on staging5 (plan F-2).
